title: Young Soldier in Helmet on Barracks Steps, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A young American soldier or recruit stands outdoors on the wooden entry stairs of a military barracks, wearing fatigue utility trousers, a field jacket, and an M1 combat helmet, with a white towel or cloth draped over his chest. The photographer's distinct silhouette is cast on the ground in the foreground. The photo reflects daily life and military camp training during the World War II era.
